118:t_019:12.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「We'll show you, $$サイデリアル$$! There are still countless people on Earth who haven't given up!」

118:t_019:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We're going on the offensive! We'll settle this in one push!」

118:t_020:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I've confirmed that all enemy units have been destroyed.」

118:t_020:1.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The Empire's soldiers inside the base are also withdrawing from this area.」

118:t_020:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I suppose we've somehow cleared the first hurdle...」

118:t_020:3.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「And we gave that obnoxious commander a good thrashing while we were at it.」

118:t_020:4.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「That was so cool, $$ノリエガ$$.」

118:t_020:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「As a tactical forecaster, I should at least be able to do this much.」

118:t_020:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Besides, we only managed it because $$カティ$$ sent us those forces.」

118:t_020:7.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Hey, she's praising us.」

118:t_020:9.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Be a little happy about it. You'll wear yourself out if you're always so guarded.」

118:t_020:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
($$エスター$$... We managed to take back your hometown.)

118:t_021:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「D-Damn you! I'll never forget this humiliation!」

118:t_021:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「The next time we meet will be your last! Wait in terror for that day!」

118:t_022:0.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Parting threats like that are pathetic.」

118:t_022:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Guys like that, who think they're clever without the ability to back it up, are hopeless.」

118:t_022:3.en:
$n
「I sense it too. I'm sure that behind him...」

118:t_023:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I've confirmed multiple enemy machines shot down...!」

118:t_023:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「That's what they get for underestimating the $$ハイパー・メガ粒子砲$$! We'll push straight through!」

118:t_100:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n, $$ジェニオン$$ is in top form! We can do this!」

118:t_100:1.en:
$n
(What is this feeling...? It's as if Miss $$スズネ$$'s heart and mine are melting together and becoming one...)

118:t_100:2.en:
$n
(Is this what it means to become true partners...?)

118:t_101:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You must be the unit commander! I'll follow the textbook and take you down!」

118:t_101:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「A man who can't even gauge his enemy's strength is their commander...?!」

118:t_101:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You...! Are you trying to mock me?!」

118:t_101:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「After seeing a man serve as both leader and pilot at once, I can't help feeling that way!」

118:t_102:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If I defeat this man, the battle will be decided!」

118:t_102:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Can a brat who mistakes recklessness for courage really stand against me?!」

118:t_102:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You don't seem to know what happens on the battlefield to people who assume they're better than their enemies!」

118:t_103:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I don't like it. A pure white machine doesn't belong on my battlefield.」

118:t_103:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「It might be amusing to stain it red with your blood and the flames of its explosion.」

118:t_103:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're so overbearing...! It's sickening to listen to!」

118:t_103:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If a man like this is their commander, there's an opening we can exploit!」

118:t_104:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll swiftly strike down the enemy commander and decide the battle!」

118:t_104:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「That is a wise decision. But there's one fatal flaw in it.」

118:t_104:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Someone like you could never defeat my $$シャウラス$$.」

118:t_104:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「I've closed with the enemy...! I'll eliminate him!」

118:t_104:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「This man...! Is he not listening to me?!」

118:t_105:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「It's the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$リアクター$$! Defeating him would make a fine prize to bring back!」

118:t_105:1.en:
$n
「I didn't get this $$スフィア$$ just so you could take credit for beating me!」

118:t_105:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Then know your place! An ordinary man like you has no right to possess a $$スフィア$$!」

118:t_105:3.en:
$n
「Who are you to tell me that?!」

118:t_105:5.en:
$n
「This power was given to me by so many people! I won't be shaken by the words of someone like you!」

118:t_106:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Then I'll simply sink this ship with my own hands!」

118:t_106:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「So you're resorting to brute force in the end?! You're even more simple-minded than I thought!」

118:t_106:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Be silent! No, I'll silence you myself!」

118:t_106:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If you think the $$トレミー$$ is still just a transport ship with $$トランザム$$, you're sorely mistaken.」

118:t_106:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Target the enemy commander's machine! Begin the attack!」

118:t_107:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
(Are you watching, boy...? I have come to fight alongside you.)

118:t_107:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Relax, $$ライトニング$$. If you try too hard, the Grim Reaper will latch onto you.」

118:t_107:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「That's just what I'd expect from the Immortal $$コーラサワー$$. Thank you for the advice.」

118:t_107:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Once you're dead, it's all over! Let's survive and fight to the end!」

118:t_107:4.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I understand! This is $$グラハム・エーカー$$, engaging!」
